_source.title: 获取扩展用户配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.returns: 配置项对应的值，不存在将返回 `undefined`

title: Get Extension user configuration
remarks.text.0: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
returns: The value corresponding to the configuration item. `undefined` is returned if it does not exist
